notes.title: Bahasa Indonesia is Now Available for Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035906/bbffbc01036d54b108526763a527d42889169a9c.png

Bahasa Indonesia has been added to Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue. Command your Krieger squad amidst the conflict of Nusanesia!  

Salute, Pilots!
Welcoming the new year of 2025, we are happy to announce a new language, Bahasa Indonesia has been added to the Prologue. Play the tutorial and some stages of the campaign for free! The prologue contains around 1-2 hours of gameplay, enough encounters to familiarize you with the game. Become the commander in the ongoing conflict in the alternate 1970s Southeast Asia, and survive the battlefield with your assigned squad!


Here's the list of languages that now is available in Krigsfront Tactics - Prologue: 

Bahasa Indonesia (Recently added)
Spanish (EU)
French
German
Polish
Russian
Turkish
Brazilian Portuguese
Simplified Chinese
Japanese
 When you play the Prologue, the language screen will appear first, where you can choose the currently available languages. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035906/2b0f431a12720bdb34f87502c8404fc7057f5d81.png


Play the prologue and leave us feedback.
Kriegsfront Tactics is still in development, and your feedback is invaluable to us. We are more than excited going into 2025 with more news that will be revealed soon. More updates are planned to be implemented in the upcoming months. If you do encounter bugs or mistranslations, feel free to reach out via our social media or the Discord Community.

notes.title: Load Up, Pilots! Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue is Now Available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035906/3b630cebec864dfe877f4dddbd6336027305cbfd.jpg

Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue is now available to play for free! 

Salute, Pilots!
Jump straight into your Krieger and defeat your enemies where factions collide for freedom and power in Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue. Experience the opening story of Kriegsfront Tactics, where you can get 1-2 hours of gameplay. You are the commander of a squad of Kriegers in the ongoing conflict in the alternate 1970s Southeast Asia. On whose side you are fighting for? Survive the jungle battlefield with all you have while your morality is tested. 

You will learn more about the ongoing conflict from the cutscenes. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035906/06ffc1b7aa07f08626ee8a30ddf6f5fe4fc46b00.png

Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue includes tutorials to help newcomers learn the basics, so there is no reason not to play it. It also serves as the opening story from a certain perspective of a faction in the conflict. Learn more about the characters involved and what they are fighting for. You also will encounter enemies that might be stronger than your squad, so be careful while exploring the depths of Nusanesia's jungle. 

A sneak peek of the tutorial for newcomers to the genre. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035906/1baafd32e5c72c361cf799b1f99cb32a49ecda0c.png

Enjoy in-game cutscenes with a diverse cast voiced by talented voice actors. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035906/ec9f8ed5b2b2cd93b55f5dcdc66b45f7ceed1fc4.png

Explore with caution. Any encounter might be the last for your squad. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035906/02bea96e31f89cc11700f661f109057d7bfdae18.png

In Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue, you can explore the depths of Nusanesia areas of mountains and forests by visiting different areas that can help your squad achieve your objectives. Fight the patrolling foes and visit places to be rewarded with supplies, upgrades, or information. No matter how big or small the importance is, keep your squad alive, even if their Krieg loses an arm or leg part. After all, Krieger mechs are expendable on the battlefield. 

Visit points of interest and learn about how the conflict affects Nusanesia.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035906/d95fe70bd58603b4b2174a7d7f569b55a6274491.png

Fend off your foes and get the spoils to upgrade your Krieger. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035906/57094dbd4ae39f9b0ee7d3f669e3d35a9718b430.png

As a commander, help your squad resupply, repair, and change their Krieger parts. Always be cautious on every corner where you don't know what lurks within might be stronger than you think. Proceed cautiously and make tactical decisions to keep your squad together. Their lives depend on your command, even when a simple operation goes awry.

Don't forget to change your loadout. In the end, Kriegers are expendable.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45035906/7986be51d69bbd45497359c0924ed9cfdc50e71a.png

Play the prologue and leave us feedback on our socials!
The prologue is still just a slice of what we offer in the full game. We are still developing more game features that will be implemented soon. By leaving feedback to us, you help us greatly to improve the gameplay. We deeply appreciate your suggestions or feedback that you feel is important to point out.

notes.title: Kriegsfront Tactics Prologue - June 2024 Dev Milestone Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/4bfc6d9f4fa8add73ea1233577095fa724368172.png

Salute, Pilots!
We are happy to inform you that our combat demo was a great success. A lot of positive responses and feedback were received from players who have tried it online and/or during events. Thank you so much!

If you have not tried the Combat Demo, please try it now here.

A Prologue Vertical Slice
Now that we've delivered the turn-based tactical mecha combat, we've been working hard to add the RPG experience into our Procedural Tactical RPG and package it into one cohesive experience.

When we say RPG, we're not just talking about the stats and leveling mechanics; we're also talking about the world, the characters, the story, and other narrative elements that make a role-playing game great. Our team has been working non-stop to tie in all the mechanics into a playable vertical slice, and after many months, that RPG vertical slice is now almost complete.

With that said, we are happy to announce that we'll be releasing this vertical slice as a prologue on Steam for FREE! It will be available for you to download on July 18, 2024.

Please tell your friends about it, and don't forget to add it to your wishlist so that you'll be notified when it is available:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2851820

The prologue doesn't have the procedural system implemented yet (that will be for another milestone update), but here are the things that you'll find in this RPG vertical slice:

Prologue Story
This vertical slice will serve as the prologue chapter, an opening introduction that kicks off the events that trigger the conflict in the full game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/b4eb5378dad50713b27a93698d75b558d93407a4.jpg

Mecha Customization & Stats
You'll be able to customize your mechs and see how your pilots level up their skills.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/32ef052bf65bc84e846eb753d9e59a48f3f8a6f9.jpg
Not only that, you can change each mech's body parts and weapon load out, you can also customize their paint job and cosmetics.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/cb73a85d2558dc4e04bd0c9e4974c06e4639d85c.jpg

Exploration
We've added a world exploration layer where you can roam around, discover new places, and encounter events that'll tell you a bit more about the characters and the world of Kriegsfront Tactics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/1c6cccd202c82a72623d327853abaafb1b9be98c.jpg

Voice Actors
And what better way to bring those characters to life than hiring some of the best voice actors?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/878ac08919195faf3e0de723c374f46069d1b7c8.jpg

Here's the current list of Kriegsfront Tactics Voice Actors:  

 Michael Gonzalez 
 Belsheber Rusape 
 Su Ling Chan
 Damon Alums 
 Craig Lee Thomas 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41803321/08adfb8040fc98e27de13a822da677d9c389ba33.png
Including this guy: Craig Lee Thomas' Helldivers 2 Spokesperson

Your support is once again required. Please wishlist the prologue so that more people will see it when it is out.
